Laurel Grove Capital Has Lifted Holding in General Motors (GM) by $648,000; As Apple (AAPL) Stock Value Rose, Shareholder Berkshire Money Management Has Boosted Its Holding
June 27, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Laurel Grove Capital Llc increased its stake in General Motors Corp (GM) by 206.9% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Laurel Grove Capital Llc bought 18,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.80% with the market. The institutional investor held 26,700 shares of the auto manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $970,000, up from 8,700 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Laurel Grove Capital Llc who had been investing in General Motors Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $57.15 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.12% or $0.46 during the last trading session, reaching $40.55. About 3.69 million shares traded. General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) has risen 17.48% since June 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 4.91% the S&P500.
